jobs.title: Senior Manager- AI Strategy & Solutions
jobs.description:
About Our Company

Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.

Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

Job Description

Integral role in supporting AIM’s data analysis, system control, and database needs. Provide strategic ideas and thought leadership. Has/can apply solid financial industry data systems knowledge to support decision and strategy problems in key business areas. Demonstrates strong technical/problem solving skills. Manages multiple projects collaboratively. Works with HR in recruitment and performance appraisal process. Mentor the team members and layout their growth path.

Role Summary
Leads the execution and operationalization of enterprise AI initiatives, ensuring AI strategy is translated into scalable, business-impacting solutions. Partners across business and technology teams to drive delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes, while maintaining strong alignment to enterprise priorities and governance. Acts as a senior program leader with end-to-end accountability for execution, value realization, and executive alignment across priority AI initiatives
Key Responsibilities
1) Enterprise AI Execution & Operationalization: Translate enterprise AI strategy into actionable roadmaps, delivery plans, and implementation milestones . Drive end-to-end execution of priority AI initiatives across multiple business areas. Ensure AI solutions move from concept to pilot to scaled deployment, and ultimately to sustained adoption. Own delivery outcomes across initiatives, including scope, timelines, and measurable business impact.
2) Program & Portfolio Delivery: Lead a portfolio of AI use cases and programs across the enterprise. Establish and manage delivery discipline (prioritization, dependencies, timelines, risk mitigation). Ensure outcomes are tied to clear business value (e.g., productivity, growth, cost, risk). Drive integrated program plans, track KPIs and milestones, and proactively manage risks, dependencies, and execution challenges, escalating as needed.
3) Cross-Enterprise Partnership Partner with Business leaders across functions, Technology, Data & Analytics team, and Risk, Legal, and Governance teams. Align stakeholders around what gets delivered and how, while shaping execution priorities and ensuring alignment to enterprise AI strategy. Engage senior leaders, including ELT stakeholders, to drive alignment, inform decision-making, and ensure transparency on progress, risks, and outcomes. Act as a clear point of accountability for progress and results.
4) Technical & Solution Leadership: Provide informed direction on AI/ML and GenAI solutions to ensure fit-for-purpose design. Bridge strategy and execution by helping teams define use cases, select appropriate approaches/models, and ensure scalability and integration. Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and translate into practical application.
5) Adoption, Change & Value Realization: Drive business adoption of AI solutions, not just delivery. Define metrics and success measures and track realization of expected outcomes. Partner with HR / change / comms teams to support workflow integration and behavior change. Ensure value realization is clearly defined, tracked, and communicated, with a focus on measurable outcomes.
6) Governance & Responsible AI: Ensure adherence to enterprise AI governance, risk, and compliance frameworks. Operationalize responsible AI practices (e.g., transparency, fairness, controls). Support approval processes and risk assessments for AI deployments. Ensure alignment to the enterprise AI operating model, embedding best practices across data, technology, risk, talent, and change management.
7) Matrix Team Leadership: Lead through influence and build strong execution capability and accountability across a broad cross-functional team. Create consistency in delivery methodologies and standards. Foster a high-performance, results-oriented environment; drive clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement across teams.

Qualifications
Required
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
- 8–10+ years in AI, data/analytics, digital, or large-scale transformation (preferably experience in strategy consulting)
- Demonstrated success in operating with an enterprise mindset and delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives
- Strong understanding of: AI/ML and GenAI applications, data platforms and enterprise technology environments

- Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly and influence across technical and business stakeholders to drive alignment and decisions

- Ability to build strong relationships and lead effectively in a matrixed environment without direct authority. Experience aligning stakeholders on priorities, trade-offs, and timelines
- Experience driving execution across multiple stakeholder groups
- Ability to translate strategy into clear, actionable plans and delivered outcomes
- Experience driving adoption and change, ensuring solutions are embedded and delivering business value
- Proven ability to exercise sound judgment, make timely decisions, and navigate ambiguity confidently
- Experience leading large-scale programs or transformation initiatives with clear accountability for outcomes
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to use data to inform decisions and optimize execution

Preferred
- Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, Data Science or related field)
- Experience leading enterprise programs
- Financial services or regulated industry experience
- Background balancing technical depth with program leadership
- Familiarity with AI governance and responsible AI frameworks
- Experience in consulting, strategy, or similar roles supporting enterprise transformation initiatives

In-Office Collaboration
We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2) days per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Trust Investment Officer
jobs.description:
About Our Company

We’re a diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. Our team of 22,000 people across 19 countries, serves more than 3.5 million individual, small business and institutional clients. We are a longstanding leader in financial planning and advice, a global asset manager and an insurer. Our unwavering focus on our clients and strong financial foundation connects each of our unique businesses – Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments and RiverSource Insurance and Annuities. Here, we foster meaningful careers, invest in the future, and make a difference for clients, institutions and communities around the world.

Job Description

As a Trust Investment Officer, you will play a pivotal role in managing fiduciary investment relationships and helping clients achieve their long-term financial goals. You will partner with Trust Administration Officers, Financial Advisors, and clients to develop and implement investment strategies that align with trust objectives and fiduciary standards. This role offers the opportunity to influence portfolio outcomes, contribute to business growth, and collaborate across a highly skilled wealth management organization. Your expertise will directly support client retention, asset growth, and exceptional trust investment management.

Key Responsibilities
- Partner with Financial Advisors and Trust Administration Officers to manage trust investment assets while upholding fiduciary standards and client objectives.

- Review asset allocations, develop Investment Policy Statements, and recommend investment strategies aligned with client goals and risk tolerance.

- Monitor portfolio performance, conduct investment reviews, and present recommendations and results to advisors, clients, and co-trustees.

- Evaluate legacy holdings, concentrated positions, and special assets, including real estate and closely held businesses, and recommend appropriate management strategies.

- Serve as fiduciary investment manager for assigned accounts, overseeing portfolio construction, rebalancing, distributions, investment monitoring, and transaction approvals.

- Participate in investment governance activities, including investment committee initiatives, proxy voting, corporate actions, and special projects.

- Support new business development by analyzing prospective portfolios, contributing investment expertise during the sales process, and assisting with trust account onboarding and funding.

- Review trust agreements, asset statements, and supporting documentation to evaluate account suitability and guide advisors through implementation and account acceptance processes.

Required Qualifications
- 5+ years of investment management experience, including trust investment management, fiduciary account oversight, and portfolio management responsibilities

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience

Preferred Qualifications
- Strong knowledge of investment strategies, asset allocation, portfolio analysis, fiduciary principles, and management of complex or special assets

- Ability to analyze investment performance, assess risk, and develop recommendations that support client objectives and regulatory requirements

- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively with clients, advisors, and business partners

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment

- Demonstrated problem-solving, collaboration, and relationship management capabilities; experience influencing stakeholders is preferred

Visa Sponsorship
Applicants must have a valid work authorization that does not now, or in the future, require visa sponsorship for employment in the United States (e.g., H-1B, F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, TN).

In-Office Collaboration
We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least four (4) days per week, with flexibility to work from home one (1) day per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

Base Pay Salary

The estimated base salary for this role is $93,400 - $128,400 / year. We have a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy. Your initial total compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographical work location. In addition, most of our roles are eligible for variable pay in the form of bonus, commissions, and/or long-term incentives depending on the role. We also have a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that supports all aspects of your health and well-being, including but not limited to vacation time, sick time, 401(k), and health, dental and life insurances.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Our Company

We’re a diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. Our team of 22,000 people across 19 countries, serves more than 3.5 million individual, small business and institutional clients. We are a longstanding leader in financial planning and advice, a global asset manager and an insurer. Our unwavering focus on our clients and strong financial foundation connects each of our unique businesses – Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments and RiverSource Insurance and Annuities. Here, we foster meaningful careers, invest in the future, and make a difference for clients, institutions and communities around the world.

Job Description

Do you have leadership experience and want to advance your career with an industry-leading firm? If so, we want you to join our team as an Operations Leader! Ameriprise Financial is America’s leader in financial planning and ranked #1 in customer loyalty.
As an Operations Leader, you will be responsible for all operational processes that support business objectives and assist advisors in serving their clients. Leverage your strong leadership skills by managing branch staff (including Registered Client Service Associates and non-registered Client Service Associates), working directly with employee advisors, and partnering with additional branch leaders. Looking to advance your career further through licensing? We are dedicated to your career development through training, mentoring and licensing support — it's all about helping you optimally develop to reach your full potential!

At Ameriprise Financial, we take pride in providing our clients with a personalized experience every step of the way; if you thrive in an environment where you can help others and create a positive impact on a client’s overall experience, we invite you to take your career to the next level by applying to join our team today!

Key Responsibilities

- Manage activities that support business results, revenue growth, client experience and efficiencies in practice. Manage resources to achieve business results, including revenue and client acquisition targets. Partner with Branch Manager to ensure advisor business plans are completed and marketing events are tracked and measured.
- Assist advisors in servicing clients including preparing financial plans, conducting investment research and completing trades and transactions. Prepare and summarize client meetings by scheduling and confirming meetings, creating an agenda and summary of meeting, escorting clients to advisors office and providing follow-up. Prepare and ensure new business paperwork processes are successfully filled out. Provide general administrative duties such as answering phones, processing reports, preparing correspondence, set-up files, etc.
- Create, manage, track and analyze reports and branch vitals. Review advisor expense reports, branch P&L, budgeting, reporting/correcting errors, identify and implement expense reduction opportunities. Partner with Registered Principal to ensure compliance support is established and training needs are met. Lead real estate and facilities initiatives.
- Lead, coach, mentor and provide performance management for direct reports. Partner with Senior Operations Leader and Regional Director of Operations to determine staffing needs; request, hire and allocate staff. Conduct 1:1s with staff.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelors degree or equivalent.
- 5-7 Relevant Experience Required.
- Previous successful supervisory experience including knowledge of HR policies and labor laws.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to motivate team members to delivery results.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast paced environment with little or no supervision and strong organizational/time management skills.
- Able to communicate with all levels within the organization.
- Detail orientated, strong math, and analytical skills. Good organization and time management skills.
- Process oriented and can work with a team. Proficient with standard business software applications.

Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications Preferred (indicate):S7, 63/66, 65/66, Life, Accident, and Health licenses (or commitment to obtain within 150 days).

Visa Sponsorship
Applicants must have a valid work authorization that does not now, or in the future, require visa sponsorship for employment in the United States (e.g., H-1B, F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, TN).

In-Office Collaboration
We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least four (4) days per week, with flexibility to work from home one (1) day per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.
